sayDuring.line: ◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A figure in a high-visibility vest, hammering signs into the dirt. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE LANDLORD! Maher, Caleb join you!
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
Maher squares up to watch. "Give it hell."
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. A Elder veteran.
It sits up on its hind legs — hands moving too fast to follow. It's not looking at you. It's looking at your pack.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.

⚔ LOCKPICK! Nikolai joins you!

Nikolai plants their feet. "Finally. A fight worth watching."
It circles once, eyes never leaving your pack — those hands never stop moving.
🖐️ Its hands blur — and suddenly it's holding your Hardlight knife! It's already running.
Nikolai strikes the Elder Lockpick.
FEASTED ×2.03: Nikolai's blow carries the feast.

raccoon is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
